title: 第3章 重生(1)
content_zh:
黑白分明的大宅院，青石板，朱红柱，雕花栏杆刻着繁复的海棠花纹。刚下过一夜的雨，雨珠自芭蕉叶上滚着掉进地上的土里。
桌上的紫金香炉做成精致的小兽模样，吐出的香是水木香，在初秋的天闻起来分外清爽。
床上四角都挂了镶着流苏的香包，色泽鲜艳。柔软的榻边，两个个子高高的丫鬟正在小心的为床上人扇扇子。
“天凉了掉水里，发热了可不得了。姑娘都睡了一天一夜，大夫说这会子该醒了，怎生没动静？”穿着青色衣服的丫鬟面上难掩焦虑。
“谷雨，都大半个时辰了，怎么大夫还没过来？”另一个紫衣丫鬟道。
“二太太那边看的紧，这算是丑事，府里都藏着掖着。”谷雨看了一眼床上人：“夫人和老爷都不在京城，大少爷也不在，老夫人又偏心东院的，白露和霜降去找大夫现在未回，莫不是被人拦住了。这是要把姑娘往绝路上逼啊！不行，我得出去看看。”
话音刚落，便听得床上的人发出一声微弱的声音。
“姑娘醒了！”紫衣丫鬟惊喜的叫了一声，连忙跑到床边，但见床上的少女揉了揉额头，慢慢的坐起身来。
“惊蛰……”沈妙喃喃道。
“奴婢在呢，”紫衣丫鬟笑着握住沈妙的手：“姑娘可还觉得好些了？睡了一天一夜，眼看着热退了却不见醒，奴婢还寻思着再去找大夫一趟。”

“姑娘，要不要喝点水？”谷雨递上一杯茶。
沈妙有些困惑的看着面前的两人。
她有四个一等丫鬟，惊蛰谷雨，白露霜降，俱是聪慧灵敏的好丫头。可惜到最后一个都没能留下来。
谷雨在她当秦国人质时，为了保护她不被秦国太子羞辱，死在了秦国太子手中。白露和霜降，一个死在陪婉瑜和亲的路上，一个死在和楣夫人争宠的后宫。
至于惊蛰，生的最为貌美，当初为了帮傅修宜上位，拉拢权臣，惊蛰自甘为妾，以美色成为权臣俯首的一大理由，最后被权臣的妻子寻了个由头杖责而死。
得知惊蛰死了之后，沈妙大哭一场，差点小产。
如今惊蛰好端端的站在自己面前，眉目依旧秀美如画，谷雨笑盈盈的看着她，两个丫鬟都是十四五岁的好年纪，让沈妙一时恍惚。
片刻，她才苦笑着闭上眼睛：“这死前的幻觉，也太过真实。”
“姑娘在说什么呢？”谷雨把茶杯放到一边，伸手来摸沈妙的额头：“莫不是烧糊涂了？”

摸在额头上的手冰凉凉的，舒适而真实，沈妙猝然睁眼，目光陡然锋利。她缓缓地低下头，看着自己的手。
那是一双白嫩纤细的手，指甲修剪的整整齐齐，生的圆润可爱，一看就是双养尊处优的手。
那不是她的手。
她的手，在陪傅修宜处理朝事，审时度势的时候已然磨的粗粝，她执笔一本一本的看账本，在秦国被当成仆妇一样的呼来喝去，在后宫为了傅明和婉瑜争斗，在冷宫浆洗衣衫，她的手生满茧子，关节肿大黑瘦，哪里是这样娇娇的模样？
“给我拿一面镜子过来。”沈妙道。她的声音还很虚弱，语气却坚定。
content_en:
The large house is clear in black and white, with bluestone slabs, vermilion columns, and carved railings engraved with complex begonia patterns. It had just rained all night, and the raindrops rolled from the banana leaves and fell into the soil on the ground.
The purple and gold incense burner on the table is made in the shape of an exquisite little animal, and the incense it emits is the fragrance of water and wood, which smells particularly refreshing in the early autumn.
There are brightly colored sachets decorated with tassels hanging on the four corners of the bed. Beside the soft couch, two tall maids were carefully fanning the people on the bed.
"It's cold and you fall into the water. It's terrible if you have a fever. The girl has been sleeping all day and night. The doctor said it's time to wake up. Why is there no movement?" The maid in blue clothes could not hide her anxiety.
"Gu Yu, it's been more than half an hour, why hasn't the doctor come yet?" Another maid in purple asked.
"The second wife is paying close attention. This is considered a scandal, and the whole house is hiding it." Gu Yu glanced at the person on the bed: "Both the madam and the master are not in the capital, and the eldest young master is not here either. The old lady is partial to the east courtyard. Bai Lu and Shuang Jiang went to see the doctor and haven't returned yet. Maybe they were stopped by someone. This is to force the girl to a dead end! No, I have to go out and have a look."
As soon as he finished speaking, he heard a faint sound from the person on the bed.
"Girl is awake!" The purple-clothed maid screamed in surprise and hurried to the bed, where she saw the girl on the bed rubbing her forehead and slowly sitting up.
"Jingzhe..." Shen Miao murmured.
"My servant is here," the purple-clothed maid smiled and held Shen Miao's hand: "Young lady, do you still feel better? After sleeping for a day and a night, and seeing that the fever has subsided but she does not wake up, this servant is still thinking about going to the doctor again."

"Girl, would you like some water?" Gu Yu handed him a cup of tea.
Shen Miao looked at the two people in front of her with some confusion.
She has four first-class maids. They are all good girls who are smart and sensitive. It's a pity that none of them could stay until the last one.
When she was a hostage of Qin, Gu Yu died in the hands of the prince of Qin in order to protect her from being humiliated by the prince of Qin. Bai Lu and Shuang Jiang, one died on the way to accompany Wanyu to get married, and the other died in the harem competing with Mrs. Mei for favor.
As for Jingzhe, she was the most beautiful one alive. In order to help Fu Xiuyi ascend to power and win over powerful officials, Jingzhe accepted herself as a concubine and used her beauty as a major reason for the powerful officials to surrender. In the end, she was scolded to death by the powerful official's wife.
After learning that Jingzhe was dead, Shen Miao burst into tears and almost had a miscarriage.
Now Jingzhe was standing in front of her in good condition, her features were still as beautiful as picturesque. Gu Yu looked at her with a smile. The two maids were both fourteen or fifteen years old, which made Shen Miao feel dazed for a moment.
After a moment, she smiled bitterly and closed her eyes: "This hallucination before death is too real."
"What is the girl talking about?" Gu Yu put the tea cup aside and reached out to touch Shen Miao's forehead: "Is it because of the fever?"
The hand touching her forehead was cold, comfortable and real. Shen Miao suddenly opened her eyes, her gaze suddenly sharp. She slowly lowered her head and looked at her hands.
They were a pair of white, tender and slender hands, the nails were neatly trimmed, and they were round and cute. At first glance, they looked like pampered hands.
Those were not her hands.
Her hands were worn rough when she was accompanying Fu Xiu Yi in dealing with court affairs and assessing the situation. She was writing account books one after another. She was treated like a servant in the Qin State and was ordered around like a servant. She fought for Fu Ming and Wanyu in the harem, washed clothes in the cold palace. Her hands were covered with calluses and her joints were swollen and dark. How could she look so delicate and delicate?
"Bring me a mirror." Shen Miao said. Her voice was still weak, but her tone was firm.
